scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run --filter '@avel/*' build
scripts.generate:validation: cd python/avel-export && uv run --locked python -m avel_export.validation ../../packages/runtime/browser/artifacts
scripts.test:browser: bun run generate:validation && bun run --filter '@avel/runtime' test:browser
scripts.generate:bench: cd python/avel-export && uv run --locked python -m avel_export.bench ../../packages/runtime/browser/artifacts/bench
scripts.bench: bun run generate:bench && bun run --filter '@avel/runtime' bench:browser
scripts.bench:history: bun run build && bun run generate:bench && bun packages/runtime/browser/run-bench.ts --history
